Structural pass — built on the repo's own tokens (app/globals.css), not a new aesthetic.
Re-skin against your style screenshots when they land.

Same row, three readers: one open item renders as the parent's task, the coach's gap, and the league's risk.

THE QUESTION TO PUT TO A REAL COACH — show both, ask which they'd open Friday night:

A (left): names visible by default. Faster to act on; risks reading as a list of failing families.

B (right): counts by lane, names behind one tap ("Show who · names show only to you"). Calmer; one tap slower to act.

Watch which one they reach for. That reaction, not our reasoning, decides the default.

Both variants keep the same rules: no response rates, no per-family history, no worst-first ordering, roster order only, access problems labelled league-owned so silence is never read as a parent ignoring the coach.
